caption: The drawing features a single object, which is a detailed outline of a tankard with a lid, done in black ink on an off-white or cream-colored background. The tankard is cylindrical, with a slightly flared base and a flat, rectangular-topped lid that fits flush with the top edge. It has a large handle attached to one side, curving outward and back toward the body with a distinctive upward curl at the upper end and a small thumb piece near the lid. The drawing is composed with clean, precise lines, emphasizing the contours and structural elements of the tankard. Midway up the body of the tankard, a small, shaded mark or monogram is present. In the lower right corner of the paper, the name "Lawrence Flynn" is signed in cursive handwriting. The composition is centered on the page and does not include any background elements or shading beyond the lines that define the tankard itself.
title: Silver Tankard
